Docs/Submission preview

Submission preview

A reproducible intake structure modeled after the benchmark code contracts. Official evaluation intake is not yet open.

Preview only

This is a preparation checklist. The leaderboard displays manuscript baseline results; community submission intake is not yet open.

Before submission

  1. Integrate the policy with the canonical environment registry.
  2. Freeze the exact code commit, task fingerprint, checkpoint, and preprocessing configuration.
  3. Run the requested stage, scene, and long-horizon tracks with shared seeds.
  4. Export per-episode evidence and aggregate metrics.

Required artifact set

SourceRepository URL, exact commit SHA, adapter entry point, install steps.
ModelPolicy name, checkpoint identity, download/access path, license.
BenchmarkTask list, robot UIDs, action layout, observation schema, instruction version.
EvaluationSeeds, scene manifest, videos, per-episode records, aggregate report.
ContactMaintainer and reproducibility contact.
